headline: Protein and DNA language models gain from injected evolutionary and structural priors
label: Biological Sequence Foundation Models
summary: Recent preprints and publications test structure-injected protein language models on fitness, stability, and deployment constraints.
synthesis: The dominant thread is augmenting pretrained protein language models with explicit evolutionary, structural, or biophysical information rather than scale alone. LEMON-ZEST derives evolution-informed tokens from conserved MSA regions, and VenusREM-Harness fuses foundation model scores with MSA evidence and structural context without training. StabilityArc decodes frozen ESMC embeddings into substitution-effect matrices, and OmegaTherm jointly predicts folding free energy and melting temperature changes. AcrSeek applies metric learning over a frozen protein language model under 1:383 class imbalance. Other items probe deployment and transfer: 4-bit quantization with QLoRA across eight protein language models, and class-incremental methods on frozen encoders, where no method transfers reliably. RAGCell extends the pattern to single-cell analysis, using LLM-built knowledge databases as supervision.
